name: Eddie
original_description: Eddie is an AI assistant video editor for footage already imported into a connected Eddie project. It helps video editors, filmmakers, creators, and teams inspect sources and transcripts; assemble and refine edits; switch multicam angles; add b-roll, captions, titles, music, graphics, grading, and reframing; and export finished videos, documents, or timelines for Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Avid, and OpenTimelineIO. Eddie requires an accessible Eddie project and does not upload local footage through ChatGPT. Generative and rendering actions may use account credits and disclose costs before paid work.
summary_ja: Eddieのプロジェクト内の映像を確認・編集し、完成動画や編集タイムラインを出力する。
limitations_ja: 利用可能なEddieプロジェクトが必要。生成やレンダリングにクレジットを使う場合がある。
